effective_date_basis: Section 607 supersedes or revokes the listed orders. The signature is August 14, 1953; relevant general provisions contain no delayed effective date. Original-image authentication remains open.

exceptions_savings.assessment: Section 606 continues prior orders, regulations and actions unless inconsistent or later changed, and preserves the force of prior acts. Section 605 continues the Economic Stabilization Agency through October 31 for liquidation. Section 608 preserves EO10182,10219,10224 subject to modifications, so they are outside whole-order scope.
leads: Section 606 strongly preserves continuing effects and prevents a blanket substantive-cessation inference.
Review liquidation, transferred functions and assets clause by clause.

legal_effect: Research lead only. Express revocation/supersession does not establish first substantive cessation, extinguish saved effects or change any provisional status.
